---
title: Speck and Fontina Omelette
id: MAR-0052
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 egg
- 80 g speck
- 80 g fontina cheese
- 2 tablespoons parsley
- 40 g butter
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the parsley, season with salt and pepper, and beat with a fork.
2. Grease a small non-stick pan with a little butter and pour a quarter of the mixture.
3. Cook the omelette on both sides, place it on a plate, and cook the others in the same way.
4. Place the speck and the fontina cheese cut into slices on each omelette and roll them up.
5. Grease a mold with the remaining butter, place the rolled omelettes in it, and pass them under the oven grill for a few minutes.
